cohort: Pregnant women who sought care due to decreased or altered fetal movements ≥ 28 week's gestation in 2014 in Stockholm, Sweden
finding: Labor was induced more often among the 2683 women who had sought care due to decreased or altered fetal movements (RR 1.4, 95% CI 1.3-1.5).
mod_finding: Induction of labor was more frequent in women who had sought care due to decreased or altered fetal movements.
